about: Printed pages of the items the paper cites for its known results (environments with `cite:` in the statement map). The paper gives reference and item but no page; build-site.py fails when a cited item has no entry here. Pages come from the paper's citation ledger and, where it had none or was wrong, from the page headers of the local PDF of the source (McConnell-Robson: PDF page = printed + 21). `null` means not checked: the local scans of Goldie 1960 and Bavula 2010 have no text layer.
corrections: McConnellRobson2001 15.4.7: the ledger gives p. 591; the item starts on p. 587 (PDF 608), and p. 591 holds 15.5.6.
